data.body: OPERATOR RULING (2026-08-21): the CONCEPT is approved. Placement question raised: does this fit as an addition to the existing code-review 'tests' criterion rather than a new criterion? Orchestrator finding: partially — the nine instances split into two populations, and only one is test code. Population 1 (five instances) was SHIPPED rebar code (gate scripts, pgrep patterns, silent lookup-miss paths); a tests-only placement misses it. Proposed disposition for the implementer: add the fail-open/producer-liveness detection language to the existing 'tests' criterion for the test-oracle population, and to the existing 'error-handling' criterion for the shipped-code population; do NOT create a new criterion unless calibration replay (the nine recorded instances) proves the pattern language cannot fire reliably from within those two hosts. Calibration AC from the ticket stands (fire on all nine pre-fix states, silent on post-fix).
